reviews.title: Unnecessary changes
reviews.text: This use to be my go to app for tracking my macros but with all the updates and changes. I feel like I have less control and customization on what I need to do to get all my macros in. I can no longer customization exactly has much protein, fats, carb, and calories I specifically want. Very disappointing and im going to have to switch to a different tracking app

It’s no longer as flexible, or as versatile as it used to be. Honestly,it’s  not worth my time, nor my money. I will be canceling the subscription.

reviews.title: Recent update
reviews.text: The recent update makes this app not has useful for me. I used to love the app. It seemed more accurate. If you forget a meal it's harder to go back and add due to the new update. Sometimes i scan and my meal isn't showing up til the next day. Horribly update. I've wasted my money.

reviews.title: Should be so much better
reviews.text: Annoying repetition of photo requirement every damn time you log a meal. There should be a feature that lets you repeat a meal from the past. If one eat a meal over and over (as one often does), we shouldn’t have to go through all the rigamarole every time. Lastly, the units! Calories recorded in oz? Everything else in metric only? Very annoying for US people.

reviews.title: Update is broken
reviews.text:
The recent update that was automatically installed today is completely broken and lacking nearly all the features that made this app useful. Units are completely wrong and make no sense, precise units for all inputs are necessary, but still are WAY off (5-10x). 

The new AI photo analysis update may work (haven’t tried it), but I never used that anyway. It’s crazy that a major overhaul update was released without any testing. There’s no way anyone tested this at all. I hope this gets reverted immediately until someone tests the update. 

I’m unable to log even a single, simple item. The subscription I paid for is effectively wasted until the app is fixed.

reviews.title: New Update

I really did enjoy the last version of this app but do not think I can continue with the new update.
